## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
Change the blend of the Kessler1M timescale and threshold: It now depends on the ascent only, w₊ = max(w, 0), and is quadratic,

    f(w) = w₊² / (w₊² + w₀²),

0 in still or descending air, 1/2 at w = w₀, → 1 for w ≫ w₀.
